name: fMRI Timeseries Extraction
summary: Nuisance-regresses fMRIPrep BOLD data with its confounds and extracts mean time series for each region of a volumetric parcellation using nilearn.
description: Runs nilearn-based nuisance regression on a preprocessed BOLD image using the fMRIPrep confounds file (strategy, band-pass filter, smoothing and spike regression are configurable), then extracts the mean time series of every parcel. Use it after fMRIPrep to get denoised BOLD and regional time series for connectivity analysis. The BOLD image, mask and parcellation must be aligned (same space); if tr is empty the TR is read from the BOLD metadata. Leave inspace at data: the code accepts only 'data' or 'labels', so the 'label' option fails.

inputs.description: From multi-atlas transfer app; should be aligned to preprocessed bold.nii.gz (i.e. same space).  The internal functions of this app will re-slice the func and the parc to be on the same voxel grid.

parameters.description: Strategy of nuisance regression, all strategies include linear de-trending

options.label: globalsig
options.description: Just global signal regression, nothing else

options.label: 24aCompCorGsr
options.description: Anatomical CompCor strategy with global signal

parameters.description: If you know the TR, you can set it here.  Script will also try to automatically read it from BL info (try this first).
FWHM of spatial smoothing kernel applied to bold.nii.gz (put 0 for no smoothing)
Add linear regressor to nuisance regression. This makes your time series generally centered around 0.
If you want a spike regressor for frames that exceed a certain FD threshold, set that threshold here. Threshold is typically in the 0.5 to 1 range; else, "9999" means no spike regressor.
In almost ALL cases, this should be set to 'data'. It will take a super long time to run the app if you set it to 'label' and you might run out of memory.

options.label: data
options.description: compute time series from data grid, resample labels

options.label: label
options.description: computer time series from label grid, resample data

parameters.description: Save the regional time series (required to produce the out_ts output).
Skip computing the correlation matrix and only extract time series.

citations.text: Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
